name: sunocoach
description: AI music creation workflow coach with community-validated patterns, style prompt engineering, and lyric structure tools.

tools.name: get_current_workflow
tools.description: Returns active workflow pattern with all steps and drift status

tools.name: get_next_step
tools.description: Returns exact instruction for current step in plain English

tools.name: log_step_result
tools.description: Stores result, advances session state, checks for drift

tools.name: generate_style_prompt
tools.description: Takes plain English, returns structured style DNA prompt

tools.name: build_lyric_structure
tools.description: Applies correct bracket tagging to raw lyrics

tools.name: validate_prompt
tools.description: Scores prompt against all rules, returns issues with fixes

tools.name: save_style_prompt
tools.description: Validates then stores in user's style library

tools.name: recall_style
tools.description: Fuzzy search user's style prompt library

tools.name: get_client_brief
tools.description: Returns ready-to-paste style prompt + lyric structure

tools.name: submit_workflow
tools.description: Contributor tier - submits new workflow for community scoring

tools.name: vote_on_pattern
tools.description: Contributor tier - vote on submitted pattern
